BiblicalUsage: Twice, and both times in a list of what people become without God. In Romans the boasters stand among the haters of God, the inventors of evil things, the disobedient to parents. In Timothy they head the last-days catalogue, lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers; the word is for the person who talks big about himself.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for a braggart carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the company it keeps, that boasting is listed beside hating God and loving self, and the end of the list is always the same.
